summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end. Backend TTS suite 8/8 pass (POST returns cached URL, GET returns audio/mpeg >1KB, empty/whitespace -> 400, unknown key -> 404, English works, cache-hit deterministic). Frontend: verses now display first-person Hindi text starting with 'मैं...' and source line 'आधार: <ref>' (e.g. 'आधार: रोमियों 4:20'). reader-bookmark-button hidden on confession/prayer steps and visible only on verse steps as required. Bookmark toggles fav — success/info toast fires and icon turns amber. open-favourites-button on Today header navigates to /favourites; saved verse shows theme tag (विश्वास), first-person text, and 'आधार:' reference; fav-remove-* removes it. Favourites persist across hard reload (localStorage). Full flow works: Today → start-confession-button → confession + 7 verses (all first-person) → prayer → appreciation-badge with +10 points & streak=1; back to Today shows 'आज पूरा हुआ' chip and 'दोबारा पढ़ें' CTA. Listen (reader-listen-button) and Share (reader-share-button) present and don't crash (web share shows 'unavailable' toast as expected). Movable-special logic verified by code inspection: computus for 2026 yields Easter=Apr 5 & Good Friday=Apr 3, and getDayContent returns curated special content with badge; fixed 12-25 Christmas special present. No red-screen errors; only cosmetic RN-web warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) that do not affect functionality.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning at runtime on web: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use style.boxShadow (non-blocking; cosmetic warning only).
props.pointerEvents is deprecated — move to style.pointerEvents on the specialWrap View (line ~252). Non-blocking warning.
Web preview warns 'useNativeDriver is not supported'. Expected on web; for native builds this is fine. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace legacy 'shadow*' StyleSheet props with boxShadow to silence RN-web warnings.
(Optional cosmetic) Move `pointerEvents="none"` on <View> in reader/[date].tsx specialWrap into style prop to silence deprecation warning.
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY currently empty — OpenAI fallback exercised and passing. When key is added, add a smoke test covering el-provider path.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside create_tts (see line 150). In practice the except block rarely triggers, but a runtime NameError would occur if ElevenLabs voice lookup fails before logger is initialised. Move logging.basicConfig / logger = getLogger to top of file (before api_router definitions).
Favourites uses id = ref.en + first 24 chars of en — sufficient for current data set but collision-prone if new verses are added; consider hashing full en for stability.
Content files are large (special.ts + content.ts) but within acceptable size (<700 lines each), no split needed.
seed_data_creation: None. Local storage state only (favourites, progress).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Public reader path /reader/<date-key>. Verse step count = 7 so full flow requires 9 next-clicks (confession + 7 verses + prayer). Appreciation route uses testID='appreciation-badge' and 'appreciation-done-button'. Favourites are localStorage-backed (key favourites_v1) and survive hard reload. ELEVENLABS_API_KEY intentionally empty in this iteration → OpenAI TTS path exercised.
